notes.title: Achievements patch
notes.content:
Hi all!

A patch has just been released that fixed achievements not unlocking on Linux and MacOS. After updating, you should be able to just run the game to claim your achievements. If that doesn't work, try completing Level 1 again.

Please don't hesitate to reach out or post in the forums with issues you encounter.

Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Fire a magical sword at goblins in the physics-based puzzler 'Sword Slinger' out now
notes.content:
Sword Slinger is a rather unique physics-based puzzle game about slaying goblins by controlling a sword with magical behaviours. Combine magical logic blocks together, to unleash amusing solutions. Out now with Linux support.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2020/10/fire-a-magical-sword-at-goblins-in-the-physics-based-puzzler-sword-slinger-out-now

notes.title: Sword Slinger is now available for purchase!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37913718/d6233d2dcd723616d2c4731d9548551d76c0a73a.gif[/img]

notes.title: Funny physics-based goblin-slaying puzzler 'Sword Slinger' is out on October 20
notes.content:
Sword Slinger is a unique physics-based puzzle game about slaying goblins by controlling a sword with magical behaviours. You'll combine chains of magical behaviours together to create complex and original solutions.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2020/10/funny-physics-based-goblin-slaying-puzzler-sword-slinger-is-out-on-october-20

notes.title: The Sword Slinger demo has been updated!
notes.content:
The demo has once again been updated! Here are the update notes:
- One additional action and one additional trigger are available in the demo
- Music has been updated
- Environment art has been added to liven things up

As always, please feel free to send me your feedback admin@firebelley.com or send me a DM on Twitter @firebelley.

I hope you enjoy!

notes.title: The Sword Slinger demo has been updated!
notes.content:
The Sword Slinger demo has been updated with some quality-of-life improvements, as well as 5 new levels! Players now have access to the first 10 levels of the game.

As always, please feel free to send me your feedback admin@firebelley.com or send me a DM on Twitter @firebelley.

I hope you enjoy the new levels!
